steps.title: Analyze User Request
steps.description: Understand the requirements for implementing an immersive 3D tactile UI and a responsive manual pull-down-to-refresh list mechanism with high-quality synthesized acoustic signals.

steps.title: Design 3D Header Graphic Layers
steps.description: Create a layer-list XML drawable to give the main app bar a gorgeous 3D extruded look with gradient fills and realistic shading.

steps.title: Design 3D Note Card Drawables
steps.description: Modify the default note card style to include soft bevel lines, drop shadow vectors, and ambient gradient depth.

steps.title: Design 3D Category Badge Layers
steps.description: Refactor the category badge shape to include deep base shadows and highlighting contours.

steps.title: Design 3D Search Field Container
steps.description: Create a recessed 3D input border to make the note filters stand out elegantly on the light workspace backdrop.

steps.title: Design 3D Floating Action Button
steps.description: Apply double-shadow rendering to the circular add button to simulate realistic physical click heights.

steps.title: Design 3D Note Editor Text Fields
steps.description: Generate an inset white 3D container with micro shadow bevels for note titles and descriptions.

steps.title: Design 3D Primary Button Shapes
steps.description: Implement a high-contrast blue bevel layer-list for the dialog's save button.

steps.title: Design 3D Secondary Button Shapes
steps.description: Construct neutral cancel and warning delete button graphics matching the 3D aesthetic specifications.

steps.title: Configure 3D Spinner Dropdown Filters
steps.description: Define drop-shadow buttons to wrap note category drop-downs with matching volumetric density.

steps.title: Update Main Layout with Pull-to-Refresh Support
steps.description: Add an interactive pull-down header view container containing a custom text status field and progress indicator inside the primary scrolling canvas.

steps.title: Update Dialog Views with 3D Assets
steps.description: Apply modern 3D field boundaries and tactile button controls inside the dialog view file.

steps.title: Implement Pull-down Detection Gestures
steps.description: Write a touch intercept listener inside MainActivity to compute resistive drag offsets, tracking drag distance when at the list's uppermost boundary.

steps.title: Synthesize Acoustic Refresh Triggers
steps.description: Build automated custom frequency waveform sequences to play satisfying sound chimes upon pull-down activation and loading completions.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Definitions and Namespaces
steps.description: Validate the namespace definition links and application metadata definitions within the manifest document.

steps.title: Building Notes Manager
steps.description: Initiate compilation using Gradle 8.5 tools to build and generate output binary successfully.
